nora: Quick follow-up from todays all-hands Q&A  we need agreed ship windows + single owner for API / Console / Optimize. Keep replies terse.

mike: Runtime notes: Optimize beta depends on batching refactor (canary 2026-06-25) and perf validation (run 2026-07-03). If perf passes, beta opens 7/18.
tara: DevEx deliverables: migration guide + Console admin quickstart + 2 reference apps. Initial drafts by 2026-07-12. Request runtime tech review week of 7/12.
sophie: Leadership priority: API streaming + function/tool calls must be green for public GA. Console UI polish is lower priority for GA; focus on admin/rollouts & dashboards.
leo: Sales ask: one-pager for reps + short FAQ for Dedicated compatibility (pilot info). Need by 2026-07-20.
dan: Scope confirm: API GA = streaming, function calls, rate limits, basic metrics. Console GA = route/model dashboards, rollout/canary UI, admin perms. Optimize beta = batching suggestions + quantization hints.
mike: Dedicated customers: autoscale changes will be piloted in August with 3 tenants. I'll post the pilot plan by 2026-07-06.
tara: Docs freeze two weeks before public GA dates. DevEx will schedule review slots with PM/Runtime.

nora: Please mark any objections on ticket #9981 by EOD Friday. If engineering surfaces blockers after the perf sweep, we'll call an immediate sync.
